parso mummy ka birthday hai, cake order karna hai. kya suggest karoge?
2:35 AM

Mummy ka birthday Sat 24 Oct ko hai, to cake kal (Fri 23 Oct) tak order kar do, taaki time par pahunch jaye. Yeh kuch achhe options hain:

Butterscotch ya black forest: sabko pasand aane wala classic.
Rasmalai ya gulab jamun cake: agar mummy ko mithai zyada pasand hai.
Fresh fruit cake: halka aur kam meetha.
Photo cake ya naam likha cake: thoda personal touch ke liye.

Mummy ko kaunsa flavour sabse zyada pasand hai? Batao to main usi hisaab se options dhoondh deta hoon.

2:36 AM

Mon 2 Nov doesn't look like a public holiday in Mumbai. I don't have the official Maharashtra holiday list in front of me, so please double-check it before you plan around it. Diwali this year falls around Sun 8 Nov, so the festival holidays come after that date.
